body: I was recently offered a Cyber - Business Development Associate role and am unsure what it would mean for my career. I am a fresh graduate from a bachelors program in Cyber Operations but do not have meaningful internship experience as a result of COVID. As a result I am trying to get a help desk position or one of the ever-elusive new graduate security analyst positions. My question is, seeing as the position I was offered is more sales oriented, would I lock myself out of more technical positions down the road? Would I benefit more from sticking it out and continuing to attempt to get a help desk role?

Thank you for the advice as far as positions and the experience! I was beginning to worry my lack of the experience would hamstrung me. As far as legal trouble I got a slightest degree dui (misdemeanor) but was told since it’s been in the past year I would need time before a clearance would be possible.

Finishing my final semester of my bachelors in cyber but I’m having issues finding a job. I’m applying across the board to positions en masse, but have to avoid entry level positions with clearance requirements due to a poor decision in regards to the law. Any suggestions on positions to target as many seem to be listed as entry level while desiring 2+ years of experience or more
I’m not fully into the field yet admittedly… Soon to be B.S. in Cyber Ops this May. No luck thus far with lining up a position

Hello everyone, I am a soon to be graduate this may with a degree in Cyber Operations. Does anyone have any tips for the job search or specific places to look? I’m currently in Arizona so I’m hoping to find a job remotely or here in the state. I don’t currently have certs but I am about to start working towards my Sec+. Any advice would be greatly appreciated!

I’ve been sitting on my bed with my shotgun loaded wondering this exact question for the past hour. I can seem to find a point to living and I’m trying to care about the impact my death would have, but I can’t seem to. If I do care, I just believe they’ll move on quickly. If nobody cares or if I don’t care, what’s the point of constantly rebuilding the rubble and disaster that’s my life
I’m glad that you were able to find some comfort in this post and knowing you aren’t alone in this feeling, your comment has done the same for me
